run_vllm_server: run a FastAPI server backed by vLLM for LLM inference with tensor and data parallelism
generate_text_completions: generate text completions from prompts via a /generate/ POST endpoint with sampling parameters
compute_sequence_logprobs: compute teacher logprobs for existing token sequences via a /get_sequence_logprobs/ POST endpoint
sync_model_weights: synchronize model weights between a training client and vLLM server workers via NCCL communicator
chat_with_messages: generate chat completions from message lists via a /chat/ POST endpoint with chat template support
